pick.name: Vercel Pro
pick.why: Best-in-class DX and first-party Next.js (ISR, image optimisation, previews); Pro is the commercial plan
pick.free_limits: Pro $20/mo incl. $20 usage credit, 10M CDN requests, 1 TB transfer. Hobby is non-commercial only (1M requests, 100 GB)

best_free.name: Cloudflare Workers (static assets + SSR)
best_free.what: Static sites, SPAs and SSR apps on Cloudflare's edge, same runtime as your APIs
best_free.why: Only top host whose free tier allows commercial use AND serves static assets free/unlimited; one platform with R2, Queues, Cron, Logs
best_free.free_limits: Static asset requests free + unlimited; dynamic: 100k req/day, 10 ms CPU/invocation, 100 Workers/account; Paid $5/mo = 10M req + 30M CPU-ms (pricing page updated 2026-10-02)

alts.name: Netlify Free
alts.why: Best free runner-up: easy previews and forms; credit model
alts.free_limits: 300 credits/mo (bandwidth costs 20 credits/GB, i.e. ~15 GB if nothing else); Personal $9, Pro $20

alts.name: Render
alts.why: Simple PaaS with free static sites
alts.free_limits: Static sites 'free, forever' per pricing page; plan tables not captured (unverified); free compute documented as not for production

candidates.name: Vercel Pro
candidates.verdict: PICK: best DX and Next.js support, $20/mo

candidates.name: Cloudflare Workers
candidates.verdict: best_free: unlimited static assets, commercial use allowed

candidates.name: Netlify
candidates.verdict: Alt: previews and forms, credit-based free plan

candidates.name: Render
candidates.verdict: Alt: simple PaaS; free compute not for production

candidates.name: Cloudflare Pages
candidates.verdict: Older product; Cloudflare steers new projects to Workers static assets

candidates.name: GitHub Pages
candidates.verdict: Rejected for products: terms forbid running an online business on it

decision: Vercel Pro is the best overall host when the app is Next.js or needs polished previews and an integrated platform; budget $20 per seat per month. Cloudflare Workers is the best free host because its free tier allows commercial use and serves static assets without limits; prefer a Vite-based framework (Astro, React Router, TanStack Start) there to avoid Next.js adapter gaps.
note: Same answer as App stacks: Vercel Pro for zero-friction Next.js, Cloudflare Workers as the free commercial option.
details: Cloudflare's Next.js guide recommends vinext (beta) with OpenNext as fallback.

verify.note: Checked against primary sources; wording made neutral during verification.
